claims.text: The Landings sits on the shores of Rodney Bay in Saint Lucia, along one of the island's most celebrated beaches.

findings.quote: Tucked on the shores of Saint Lucia’s iconic Rodney Bay, along one of the island's most celebrated beaches

claims.text: The Landings is an all-suite resort set beachfront on white sands.

findings.quote: Set beachfront on pristine white sands and azure waters, sophistication meets island authenticity at our exquisite all-suite resort.

claims.text: Each villa has an expansive terrace with views of the marina or the Caribbean Sea.

findings.quote: each villa boasts expansive terraces and stunning views of the Marina or the Caribbean Sea

claims.text: The suites are multi-room, with kitchens and living areas.

findings.quote: From exceptionally spacious, multi-room suites with kitchens and living areas

claims.text: The spa is on the second floor of the resort lobby and has eight treatment rooms and outdoor hydrotherapy terraces.

findings.quote: Located on the second floor of the resort lobby, our full-service Spa in Saint Lucia offers a deceptively expansive and serene setting, featuring eight luxurious treatment rooms, outdoor hydrotherapy terraces

claims.text: The spa uses services and products from Natura Bisse.

findings.quote: The Spa at the Landings offers an array of services and products from Natura Bisse

claims.text: The spa offers oncology-focused treatments performed by oncology-trained therapists.

findings.quote: Our oncology-focused treatment menu is thoughtfully crafted to support those undergoing cancer care
Performed by oncology-trained therapists

claims.text: The Kids Club, included in the stay, welcomes children aged 4 to 12, seven days a week.

findings.quote: Included in your stay, we welcome children aged 4 – 12, 7 days a week
Kids Club

claims.text: The resort offers babysitting services and baby proofing for all villa suites.

findings.quote: is also pleased to offer babysitting services and baby proofing for all villa suites

claims.text: Sports and fitness programs include daily workouts, personal training, racket sports and group yoga classes.

findings.quote: Fill your days with everything from daily workouts and personal training to racket sports, group yoga classes and more.

claims.text: Meals feature fresh catch and organic, sustainable produce sourced from the Caribbean and the hills of Saint Lucia.

findings.quote: Sourced from the warm waters of the Caribbean and the lush hills of Saint Lucia, every meal features the freshest catch and organic and sustainable produce and ingredients.

claims.text: Suru serves Asian fusion cuisine and handcrafted cocktails.

findings.quote: ### Suru
Asian Fusion Cuisine & Handcrafted Cocktail

claims.text: A private marina flows through the heart of the resort and is the departure point for dive trips, snorkel tours and sightseeing charters.

findings.quote: At The Landings, a modern, private marina flows through the heart of the resort. A favorite feature for seafaring guests and the departure point for dive trips, snorkel tours, and sightseeing charters

claims.text: Many of the villas have private plunge pools.

findings.quote: with many offering private plunge pools

claims.text: The spa's Signature Bamboo Massage Ritual is a locally sourced and produced therapy derived from Saint Lucia's national plant.

findings.quote: Treat yourself or someone special to our world-famous Signature Bamboo Massage Ritual. This locally sourced and produced therapy, derived from the national plant of Saint Lucia

claims.text: Butler service is included with Beachfront and Ocean View Suites and available with Marina View Suites on request.

findings.quote: Included with our Beachfront and Ocean View Suite and available with Marina View on request, your personal butler is a trusted assistant and guide

claims.text: The spa offers personalized treatments for issues such as menopause, hormonal imbalances, postpartum recovery, aging and menstrual discomfort.

findings.quote: personalized treatments tailored to address issues such as menopause, hormonal imbalances, postpartum recovery, aging, and menstrual discomfort

claims.text: The Teens Program is seasonal.

findings.quote: seasonal Teens Program

claims.text: For in-suite grocery provisioning, the resort notes island prices may be two to three times higher than U.S. prices.

findings.quote: Please select your desired groceries and we will gladly stock them in your suite. Please note that island prices maybe 2–3 times higher than that of U.S. prices

claims.text: Advance spa reservations are highly recommended.

findings.quote: Advance reservations are highly recommended.
